segments.text:
V. 29.
Take my Yoke upon you—Believe in me: Receive me as your Prophet, Prieſt, and King: For I am meek and lowly in heart—Meek toward all Men, lowly toward GOD: And ye ſhall find reſt—Whoever therefore does not find Reſt of Soul, •s not meek and lowly. The Fault is not in the Yoke of Chriſt: But in thee, who hath not taken it upon thee. Nor is it poſſible for any one to be diſcontented, but thro' Want of Meekneſs or Lowlineſs.
